label: Pixel-art Kangentic mascot

none.label: no animation
none.note: the default, and the reduced-motion rendering

blink-loop.label: blinking
blink-loop.note: idle life. The human-blink model: gaps clustered short with the odd long pause rather than a flat spread, and an occasional double blink. The rate that falls out of the range is shown on the card, so it cannot go stale when the range is tuned

wave-once.label: single arm wave
wave-once.note: a greeting, or the payoff when a connection lands. One arm, five steps. The key stays `wave-once` because kangentic-mobile's animation union already uses that string

double-arm-wave-once.label: double arm wave
double-arm-wave-once.note: both arms up together: he is trying to get your attention. The urgent one - it says 'over here', not 'hello'. Same 120ms step rate as the single arm wave, because it is the same mechanic on the same body part

double-arm-alternating-wave-once.label: double arm alternating wave
double-arm-alternating-wave-once.note: arms pump alternately rather than together, which reads as playful where the double arm wave reads as urgent. Kept as its own sequence, not an alternate: the two say different things

looking-left-and-right-loop.label: looking left and right
looking-left-and-right-loop.note: the gaze shifts side to side, looking for something that has not arrived yet. The base waiting idle. Deliberately long dwells - a wait screen loops indefinitely, so this has to read as calm, not as a twitch

running-loop.label: running
running-loop.note: legs cycling on the spot, which reads as running. Middle foot up, then the outer two. Chosen over an alternating outer-foot march at the 2026-07-25 review - with three legs and a planted centre, a march reads as nothing recognisable

waiting-loop.label: waiting
waiting-loop.note: the legs never stop - he runs on the spot the whole time, glancing left and right as he goes. Permanent running means the legs are baked into every frame, so at the 4-frame motion budget this carries running plus ONE other behaviour; the gaze won it over the arms. Fire a wave sequence separately if the wait needs a bigger signal
